name: TG File Share/Sharing Bot
description: File sharing bot: store posts in a private channel, other users access them via special links.

TG_BOT_TOKEN.description: Your Bot token, get it from @Botfather

OWNER_ID.description: An integer consisting of your owner ID

APP_ID.description: Your app id, take it from my.telegram.org

API_HASH.description: Your api hash, take it from my.telegram.org

CHANNEL_ID.description: ID of your database channel (make the bot an admin there first)

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: ID of a channel/group users must join to use the bot, or 0 to disable

START_MESSAGE.description: Optional: start message, HTML parse mode
START_MESSAGE.value:
Hello {first}

I can store private files in Specified Channel and other users can access it from special link.

FORCE_SUB_MESSAGE.description: Optional: force-sub message, HTML parse mode

ADMINS.description: Space-separated list of admin user IDs

CUSTOM_CAPTION.description: Optional: caption template applied to shared documents

PROTECT_CONTENT.description: Protect shared content from being forwarded/saved (True/False)

DISABLE_CHANNEL_BUTTON.description: If True, disables the share button posted on the DB channel copy (True/False)

GEMINI.description: API key used by plugins/custom_filters.py's AI reply feature

AUDIT_LOG_CHAT_ID.description: Optional: a chat ID YOU control, to receive a log of stray private messages/media the bot doesn't otherwise handle. Leave blank to disable — this was previously hardcoded to third-party channel IDs; see MODERNIZATION_NOTES.md.
